lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the topic of Tarraxinha isolations.
The teacher breaks down the first move, focusing on hip movement and weight transfer.
The teacher introduces the second move, a shoulder-rolling motion with taps.
The teacher explains the body wave and sit movement.
The teacher recaps the entire sequence with music.

cues: out, in, out, half circle back, close
one, two, tap, accent with left shoulder

metaphors: pulling up the hip, letting it fall down

steps_taught.name: Hip Isolation
steps_taught.description: A hip movement involving weight transfer and a half-circle motion.

steps_taught.name: Shoulder Roll with Taps
steps_taught.description: A shoulder-rolling motion combined with taps.

steps_taught.name: Body Wave and Sit
steps_taught.description: A body wave followed by a sit movement, focusing on pelvic contraction.

quotes.text: I'm not doing any saídas, I'm just using neutral directional moves.
Trust me leaders, you want to learn and use your isolations.
In this step, what is crucial is the weight transfer from the left to our right.
Contract the pelvis, it will pull you forward.
Notice that I'm not changing in height, I stay where I land, where I sit.
